answer: Operator-Linked Residual Forfeiture. Each identity maps to an operator via a signed inlet record at registration; operators post a perishable opal reserve covering all their identities. If any identity is proven sybil, the operator's entire reserve forfeits, not just that wallet's deposit. To forge a fresh wallet costs nothing, but re-registering under the same operator requires rebuilding the full reserve, so N sybils cost N times the reserve. Honest operators keep one reserve; attackers pay per identity.
